facts.finding: SDK tools/call request may resolve decoded value before the current session/abort check throws. The current catch retains sent but not that value.
The local sent mark is set before super.send, so it is not proof of successful stdin delivery, remote execution or billing.
Post-call authorize and response-record guards currently require active execution authority; currentness failure can prevent durable capture of an already returned response.
Current resume references include raw state.artifacts except lifecycle-blocked refs; a ref whose labels exceed the current policy prevents checkpoint construction.
authorizedWork intersects policy with the reader but does not filter stored artifact references by those narrowed labels.

reviewRequirements: Keep append-only custody tied to original dispatch/intent separate from present body adoption and model/channel disclosure.
Do not invent decoded response data when the SDK request rejected before resolving.
Do not weaken current StoredToolResults body proof merely to settle a measured local count.
Explicit data lifecycle invalidation/deletion is not covered by a generic late-custody exception.
Validate ordinary entry status and stop/reopen behavior after receiving hidden custody refs; lower policy must not reveal body metadata through unchecked context projection.
Retain original timestamp meanings and distinguish local call attempt accounting from unknown remote effects or charges.
